## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the repository conventions in `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] I built or otherwise validated the affected behavior where the required
      Windows, DirectX, GPU, and DXC environment was available.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation, configuration, shaders, and assets.
- [ ] I did not add generated build output, IDE state, binaries, or secrets.
- [ ] I linked related issues and documented any known limitations.
